newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT consortium to launch satellite in July.
newsitem.headline: PLDT consortium to launch satellite in July.

text.p: The Mabuhay Philippine Satellite Corp, a consortium led by the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, will start the operation of its $250-million satellite by July this year.
Mabuhay president Cesar Reyes told Reuters on Friday the satellite will be ready for shipment to its launch site in China by the first week of May.
Reyes said the entire $250 million investment will be recouped within five years.

The satellite will be the Philippines second after the first was launched in November last year to provide communications services for the leaders summit of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum.

PLDT has a 51 percent stake in Mabuhay. Other members of the consortium are unlisted PT Pasifik Nusantara, China Everbright International Ltd and unlisted Philippine firms Republic Broadcasting Corp and Philippines Communications Satellite Co Inc.
